text.aria-label: Subtitle text 'Mean quantile score difference in each local valid month; below zero means the first arm of the contrast scored better. Exploratory, and each month holds 5 to 7 weeks of forecast start. Five Primary substations, daylight half-hours of April to September, forecast runs one every 5 days: July to September 2025 and April to June 2026. Quantile score in points of capacity (1 point is 1% of a substation's capacity).'
